games.name: BACKGAMMON
games.description: Dice, blots, and the bar. Full movement rules — both dice, higher die, honest bear-offs.
games.summary: Dice, blots, zero mercy.

games.name: BATTLESHIP FFA
games.description: Free-for-all fleets — everyone fires at everyone, the kill feed tells the room. QUICK 8×8 or CLASSIC 10×10.
games.summary: Hidden fleets. Everyone's a target.

games.name: BINGO
games.description: Every phone is a card and the caller runs right on your screen. Number or picture bingo, lines / corners / blackout. Tap to daub, shout BINGO — or let little kids auto-play. Optional big-screen caller board.
games.summary: Daub your card. First to the pattern shouts BINGO.

games.name: BLUFF
games.description: Prototype bluffing card game (working title). Two hidden roles, claim any power, challenge the liars, block the attacks. Last one with a card left wins. Test bots can fill seats.
games.summary: Claim anything. Get caught, lose a card.

games.name: BRICKADE
games.description: Defend your goal, smash the bricks, grab power-ups — one bouncing ball everyone fights to own. 2 players is Pong; 3–8 makes a polygon arena where you each guard a wall. Last standing wins.
games.summary: Pong-royale meets Breakout. Own the ball.

games.name: BUZZ BOARD
games.description: A Jeopardy-style clue board takes over the TV while every phone becomes a selector, buzzer, answer pad, and secret wager slate. Find the HOT CLUE, survive the power surge, then risk it all on LAST CALL.
games.summary: Pick a square. Beat them to the buzzer. Risk it all.

games.name: CATEGORY BLITZ
games.description: Name things in the category before the sand runs out — answers that match another player cancel. 455 categories.
games.summary: Name things. Fast. Don't match.

games.name: CHARADES
games.description: One actor, everyone races to type it first. Same room, eyes up — 1,000+ subjects across 11 decks.
games.summary: One actor. Everyone races to type it.

games.name: CHECKERS
games.description: Jump or be jumped — forced captures (toggleable), kings, the whole playground feud.
games.summary: Jump or be jumped.

games.name: CHESS
games.description: The classic, refereed by a real rules engine. Solo? A bot takes the other chair.
games.summary: Think three moves ahead.

games.name: CONNECT FOUR
games.description: Four in a row, gravity does the rest. The quick one between bigger games.
games.summary: Four in a row. Gravity does the rest.

games.name: DODGEBALL
games.description: Real-time arena dodgeball on your phone — floating joystick, slingshot aim, dash to dodge, catch to send them out. Bots fill the court. Solo or up to 8, free-for-all or teams.
games.summary: Run, throw, dodge. Last one standing.

games.name: EUCHRE
games.description: 24 cards, bowers, stick-the-dealer. Order it up, go alone, or get euchred trying.
games.summary: Order it up. Go alone. Get euchred.

games.name: FAM FEUD
games.description: Our take on the family survey showdown — face-off, three strikes, steal the pot. 1v1 or split into teams.
games.summary: Survey says… head-to-head or teams.

games.name: FORT FLING
games.description: A two-player slingshot showdown built for phones. Take turns flinging boulders, bombs, clusters, rockets, and ricochets from a limited weapon belt.
games.summary: Pull back. Pick a weapon. Wreck their fort.

games.name: Gauntlet II
games.summary: Two heroes, one dungeon. Every phone is a controller and a screen.

games.name: GRIDIRON
games.description: Two teams turn every phone into a football position. Call hidden plays, tilt to break into the open field, raise your hands for the catch, and time the game-saving tackle while the whole drive unfolds on the TV.
games.summary: Call the play. Make the catch. Own the field.

games.name: HEARTS
games.description: No partners, no mercy — dodge the hearts, fear the Queen of Spades, shoot the moon. Solo vs 3 bots works.
games.summary: Duck the queen. Dodge the points.

games.name: ORBIT RIOT
games.description: Aim a neon comet in secret, then everybody launches at once. Curve around the black hole, smash rivals through the void, and bank stars in a server-physics spectacle on the TV.
games.summary: Pool meets pinball. Everybody launches at once.

games.name: PRICE CHECK
games.description: An item comes up and everyone locks in a price on their phone. Closest wins — or closest without going over. 112-item bank, real-guess reveal. Optional big-screen view.
games.summary: Guess the price. Closest wins.

games.name: RUMMIKUB
games.description: Open with 30, then legally wreck the table. 5-6 players auto-switches to the double tile set.
games.summary: Open with 30. Then wreck the table.

games.name: SMELTER SKELTER
games.description: Turn every phone into a hook-and-reel controller, then swing through a live industrial physics arena on the TV. Haul volatile cargo, hook rivals out of the air, and steal the winning delivery before the smelter overloads.
games.summary: Hook. Swing. Steal the cargo.

games.name: SNAKE ARENA
games.description: Real-time arena snake for up to 8 — golden apples, corpse pellets, best-of-3. Swipe to steer.
games.summary: Don't hit anything. Especially yourself.

games.name: SPADES
games.description: Partnership trick-taking to 500. Bots fill the empty chairs — 2 humans and the table is live.
games.summary: Partnership trick-taking to 500.

games.name: TANKS
games.description: Artillery duels on destructible terrain — angle, power, wind, and no hard feelings. 2-6 tanks.
games.summary: Angle. Power. Apologize later.

games.name: TEXAS HOLD'EM
games.description: Real No-Limit Texas Hold'em — blinds, side pots, all-in showdowns. Bots fill the table with 3 skill tiers. Solo or up to 9-handed; last player with chips wins.
games.summary: No-Limit Hold'em. Last stack standing.

games.name: THE FIFTH SIGNAL
games.description: A cooperative space-station crisis built for your crew. Every phone becomes a different private console with one piece of the solution. Relay codes, stabilize systems, and lock the signal together. Three to five players; missing stations fuse into balanced dual-role consoles.
games.summary: Five consoles. One signal. Nobody has the whole answer.

games.name: TRIVIA BUZZER
games.description: 610 questions, buzzer lockouts and steals, or the everyone-answers speed race. Kids Zone included.
games.summary: Buzz first. Think later.

games.name: WEREWOLF
games.description: Phones hold the secrets: night crimes, seer visions, day votes. The app is the moderator. Needs 5.
games.summary: Someone here is lying.

games.name: WORD RUSH
games.description: One rack of letters, everyone races to spell as many words as they can before the clock runs out. Longer words score more; a full-rack word earns a bonus. 80,000-word dictionary; optional big-screen leaderboard.
games.summary: Same 7 letters. Race to find the most words.

games.name: WORDCLASH
games.description: Multiplayer wordle: duel, relay, sabotage. Everyone plays their own board on their phone; optional wall-tablet spectator view at /tv.
games.summary: Duel. Relay. Sabotage.

games.name: Bomberman Party Edition
games.summary: Up to four bombers on one arena. Phones are the controllers.

games.name: Worms Armageddon
games.summary: One controller, up to four players taking turns.
